variants.headline: New settlers land from the ship
variants.sub: The ship in port has brought new settlers who landed at {district}.
variants.body:
New settlers have landed from the ship at {district}. The number arriving is {migrants}. Their arrival is an entry into the colony, not a complete account of the lives that follow. For {target}, the relevant question concerns responsibility towards newcomers as people rather than merely an addition to a count.

Our movement believes belonging should have a political meaning beyond a greeting. Newcomers deserve to be considered through the common responsibilities of the colony, without being made into a convenient symbol. A principled account should ask what it means to join a community rather than assume a landing settles the question.

We judge {target} critically. A landing should not place the treatment of newcomers beyond question; people joining the colony deserve a more serious standard than a welcoming description with practical responsibility left outside it. Political principle should remain visible when judgment becomes less comfortable.
